summary: First art direction pass: character visual design recommendations for Capture Arena. Proposed chunky capsule body + sphere head replacing all-box construction. Designed 3-tier same-color team differentiation (pointer, label styling, ground ring). Delivered as companion page.

Created visual character design companion page with Canvas 2D mockups: capsule body redesign, same-color team differentiation system, palette assessment, game-scale readability test, territory harmony check, and implementation priorities
Director rejected capsule/sphere bodies. New direction: box-only characters (Paper.io 2 / Crossy Road style). Created character-design-v2.html companion page.
Rebuilt character-design-v2.html: replaced all 2D canvas drawings with live interactive Three.js scenes using BoxGeometry only
Fixed character-design-v2.html: 35 WebGLRenderers exceeded browser limit (~16 contexts). Replaced with single shared WebGLRenderer + 2D canvas blit pattern. Zero errors/warnings now.

BUG FIX: Rewrote character-design-v2.html rendering to render-to-image approach. 1 WebGL context during init, 0 at runtime. Pre-rendered 24 rotation frames as PNG data URLs for drag/auto-rotate. Async init with GPU yields between sections. Zero errors/warnings.

Shipped visual direction plan: docs/visual-direction-plan.md + tools/companion/visual-direction.html (4 live Three.js art-direction mockups: A:Sunset, B:Neon, C:Painted, D:Voxel). 24-item prioritized add-list across 5 tiers. Recommended D primary, A safety, B cosmetic. ComfyUI unreachable, pivoted to live-WebGL mockups (more useful for lighting/animation/VFX comparison than static gens).
Round 2: per-direction claim/kill/respawn FX, notifications, banners, countdown, win FX. Updated companion mockup with 8 trigger buttons per direction, FX matrix table, plan doc Sections 7-15.
